items.text: Universal problems here are 2-universal: solutions defined up to equivalence. 2-inverse limit $\mathbb L$ of a pseudo-functor $I\to$ 2-category; 2-direct limits in the opposite 2-category; the sum of the $I_\lambda$ is a 2-sum.
Existence problems
(1) Existence of the enveloping $D$-category $\widehat J$ of a small category $J$.
Universe $\mathcal U$: $\operatorname{Hom}_C(X,Y)$ is $\mathcal U$-small; $C$ itself may be large (categories of groups, rings in $\mathcal U$).
Example: sums are universal
$D'$: finite products; $D''$: sums of $\mathcal U$-small families. Axiom:
X=\coprod_\alpha x_\alpha,\quad X'\to X,\quad X'_\alpha=x_\alpha\times_XX'\ \Longrightarrow\ X'=\coprod_\alpha X'_\alpha
A diagram of this shape in $C$ = a functor $\widetilde J\to C$ ($\widetilde J$ the envelope of the diagram category $J$).
\coprod_\alpha X'_\alpha\longrightarrow X'\ \ \text{in }\widetilde J\ \text{ must become invertible}
(2) Inverting arrows in $\mathbf{Cat}_D$
$J\in\mathbf{Cat}_D$, $\Sigma\subset\operatorname{Fl}(J)$: want $J[\Sigma^{-1}]\in\mathbf{Cat}_D$ with
\operatorname{Hom}_D\bigl(J[\Sigma^{-1}],C\bigr)\ \xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\ \operatorname{Hom}_D(J,C;\Sigma)=\{\varphi\colon J\to C:\ \varphi(\Sigma)\ \text{invertible}\}
Assumed to exist (possible trouble if neither $D'$ nor $D''$ is small).
Elementary exactness property

Data: a diagram $\Delta$; diagrams $\Delta'_i$, $\Delta''_j$ in $\Delta$ with vertices $x'_i$, $x''_j$ and cones/cocones; a second family $\Lambda'_\alpha$, $\Lambda''_\beta$ with vertices $y'_\alpha$, $y''_\beta$.

Condition: for every realisation of $\Delta$ in $C$ in which $x'_i=\varprojlim\Delta'_i$ and $x''_j=\varinjlim\Delta''_j$, one has $y'_\alpha=\varprojlim\Lambda'_\alpha$ and $y''_\beta=\varinjlim\Lambda''_\beta$.
Conjunctions of elementary exactness properties are again of this form (take the union of the $\Delta$'s).
In terms of the envelope: $\Sigma$ = the comparison arrows in $\widetilde\Delta$, $I=\widetilde\Delta[\Sigma^{-1}]$; exactness property = every $\varphi\colon I\to C$ inverts the arrows $\Lambda$.
Cases of interest: $D'$ = all finite diagrams, $D''=\varnothing$ (left exact functors); topoi.
\mathbf{Cat}_{D,\eta}\ \subset\ \mathbf{Cat}_D\ \ \text{full: limits of type } D',D''\ \text{and exactness properties } \eta
Algebraic structures
Want: a type of structure $T$ and, for each $C$ in the class, the category $T(C)$ of realisations of $T$ in $C$.
T=\text{group structure}:\quad T(C)=\{\text{group objects of } C\},\ \text{morphisms = compatible with the group laws}
